blocks.explanation:
Yeh "show that" wala sawal hai: humein dikhana hai ke dono sides barabar hain.
Plan: left side ke dono terms factorials mein likhein, denominators barabar karein, common factor nikalein aur simplify kar ke \({}^{21}C_{7}\) tak pahunchein. Aakhir mein numbers se tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \({}^{20}C_{7} + {}^{20}C_{6}\).
Saabit karna hai: yeh \({}^{21}C_{7}\) ke barabar hai.
Tareeqa: \({}^{n}C_{r} = \frac{n!}{r!\,(n-r)!}\). Do fractions jama karne ke liye pehle denominators ek jaise karne parte hain, bilkul aam fractions ki tarah.

Denominators barabar karein
\[\dfrac{20!}{7!\,13!} = \dfrac{20! \cdot 14}{7!\,14!}\]
\[\dfrac{20!}{6!\,14!} = \dfrac{20! \cdot 7}{7!\,14!}\]
Kyun: Pehle term mein \(13!\) hai, use \(14!\) banane ke liye 14 se zarb chahiye, kyunke \(14! = 14 \cdot 13!\). Doosre term mein \(6!\) ko \(7!\) banane ke liye 7 se zarb, kyunke \(7! = 7 \cdot 6!\). Upar bhi wahi zarb kiya taake value na badle.

Jama karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{20!\,(14 + 7)}{7!\,14!}\]
\[= \dfrac{20! \cdot 21}{7!\,14!}\]
\[= \dfrac{21!}{7!\,14!}\]
Kyun: Ab dono ka denominator ek hai, is liye numerators jama kiye aur \(20!\) common nikala. \(14 + 7 = 21\), aur \(21 \times 20! = 21!\) (factorial ki definition).
Dhyan dein: \(20! \cdot 21\) ko \(420!\) ya kuch aur na samjhein; yeh bas agla factorial \(21!\) hai.

Natije ko pehchanein
\[\dfrac{21!}{7!\,(21-7)!} = {}^{21}C_{7} = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: Yeh bilkul \(n = 21\), \(r = 7\) wala combination formula hai, kyunke \(21 - 7 = 14\).

Tasdeeq: numbers se
\[{}^{20}C_{7} = 77520,\quad {}^{20}C_{6} = 38760\]
\[77520 + 38760 = 116280\]
\[{}^{21}C_{7} = 116280 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono sides ek hi number hain. Yeh asal mein Question 14 wala Pascal ka rule hai, \(n = 20\) aur \(r = 7\) ke saath.
